module: Editor tool 'Terrain And Road Importer': imports a terrain from a 16-bit grayscale PNG (height = value/65535 x zMax), or deforms the terrain toward vertices (IDW) read from a JSON, and imports roads from a JSON (list of roads, each a list of nodes {x,y,width}). The roads become DecalRoads (material road_asphalt_2lane, in a 'Terrain And Road Importer' SimGroup) and the terrain is terraformed around them (domain of influence DOI + margin) to match the road. Requires a TerrainBlock in the scene (otherwise the functions return without doing anything) and the editor_terrainEditor module.
notes: The edit mode (terrainToLine icon) is only registered if license.isValid() is true.
The imported terrain is limited to 2001x2001 samples (xBmp/yBmp <= 2000); conformTerrainToPeaks works on a fixed 2000x2000 grid with power-2 IDW (costly) and caps heights at 250 m.
importRoads: the DecalRoads are placed at +10 m in z then conformTerrainToRoad flattens the terrain under the road; map.reset() is called to recompute the navgraph.
reset() deletes the 'Terrain And Road Importer' folder but sets ALL the terrain back to z=0 (not only the imported area).
importTerrain: if the PNG fails to load, an error is logged but processing continues anyway (no return).
Slider values: zMax 0-500 m (default 400), DOI 1-500 m (default 150), margin 0-20 m (default 7).

conformTerrainToPeaks.desc: Deforms the local terrain toward given vertices: reads a JSON [{x,y,z}], converts to grid coordinates, interpolates by IDW on a 2000x2000 grid and writes the heights (0 to 250 m) into the TerrainBlock, then marks it as modified.

filepath.desc: Path of the .json file containing the list of vertices {x,y,z}.

importTerrain.desc: Imports a terrain from a 16-bit PNG: applies each texel (x value/65535 x zMax) to the heightmap, updates the grid then reloads the collision (be:reloadCollision).

zMax.desc: Height (m) corresponding to the maximum value of the PNG: the terrain is mapped onto [0, zMax].

importRoads.desc: Imports roads from a JSON (list of roads, each a list of {x,y,width}): places each node on the terrain height, triangulates the roads, conforms the terrain around (DOI/margin), creates the DecalRoads in a scene folder and resets the navgraph.

reset.desc: Deletes the imported roads folder ('Terrain And Road Importer') and sets the heightmap to z=0 everywhere.

toggleWorldEditor.desc: Opens or closes the world editor (editor.setEditorActive).

isOpen.desc: true to open, false to close.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor render hook: if the tool is active, draws the window with the buttons Conform To Peaks, Import Terrain, Import Roads, Reset (they open a file picker) and the three sliders zMax / Domain Of Influence / Margin.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor initialization hook: if the license is valid, registers the terrainAndRoadImporterEditMode edit mode and the tool window.
